"""Verify an unchanged Sena implementation against the fully preserved Gena parent."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = P.parents[1]
W = ROOT / '.direnv/friendly-hortative-sena'
OUT = W / 'docs/friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-preservation-proof-archive.json'
assert not OUT.exists()
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
before_path = P / 'friendly-hortative-sena-before-gena-parent-merge.json'
before = json.loads(before_path.read_bytes())
def raw(label, name):
    row = before['files'][label + ':' + name]; packed = Path(row['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(packed) == row['archive_sha256']
    body = gzip.decompress(packed)
    assert sha(body) == row['source_sha256'] and len(body) == row['bytes']
    return body
assert (W / 'tests/fixtures/validity.json').read_bytes() == raw('main', 'tests/fixtures/validity.json')
assert (W / 'docs/inventory-reviews.json').read_bytes() == raw('main', 'docs/inventory-reviews.json')
ledger = json.loads((W / 'tests/fixtures/validity.json').read_bytes())
old = json.loads(raw('sena', 'tests/fixtures/validity.json'))
assert len(ledger['cases']) == 35764 and ledger['cases'][:35740] == old['cases']
assert all(ledger['sources'][key] == value for key, value in old['sources'].items())
assert {k:v for k,v in ledger.items() if k not in ['cases','sources']} == {k:v for k,v in old.items() if k not in ['cases','sources']}
reviews = json.loads((W / 'docs/inventory-reviews.json').read_bytes())
old_reviews = json.loads(raw('sena', 'docs/inventory-reviews.json'))
assert len(reviews['entries']) == 520 and reviews['entries'][:519] == old_reviews['entries']
assert {k:v for k,v in reviews.items() if k!='entries'} == {k:v for k,v in old_reviews.items() if k!='entries'}
assert len(before['production_inputs']) == 44 and all(sha((W/name).read_bytes()) == h for name,h in before['production_inputs'].items())
assert sha((W/'tests/fixtures/friendly-hortative-sena-validity.json').read_bytes()) == 'd85973f2aa29dc5f82b3710f23b46f7dad8e67785cbf4b04d8edfc81056f91be'
assert sha((W/'tests/fixtures/friendly-hortative-sena-source.json').read_bytes()) == '7a9f33eb603ac7313086069a566372f0a848a69da1e1bf2aa38952dde12870e3'
assert sha((W/'web/src/grammar-labels.json').read_bytes()) == json.loads((P/'friendly-hortative-sena-complete-runtime-binding.json').read_bytes())['frontend_inputs']['web/src/grammar-labels.json']
checklist = (W/'docs/coverage-checklist.md').read_text()
assert checklist.count('**COV-017db ') == checklist.count('**COV-017dc ') == checklist.count('**COV-017cw ') == 1
paths = {Path(row['path']).name: Path(row['path']) for row in before['files'].values()}
paths.update({before_path.name:before_path, 'prepare_sena_gena_parent_merge.py':P/'prepare_sena_gena_parent_merge.py'})
files = {}; destination = W/'docs/friendly-hortative-sena-gena-parent-preservation-proof'; destination.mkdir()
for name,path in sorted(paths.items()):
    body = path.read_bytes(); packed = gzip.compress(body,mtime=0); target = destination/(name+'.gz'); target.write_bytes(packed)
    assert gzip.decompress(target.read_bytes()) == body
    files[name] = dict(path=str(target.relative_to(W/'docs')),source_sha256=sha(body),archive_sha256=sha(packed),bytes=len(body))
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(dict(state='complete-original-Sena-and-Gena-parent-preserved',files=files,
                              original_sena_head=before['sena_head'],gena_main_parent=before['main_head'],
                              original35740_cases_and519_reviews_unchanged=True,
                              exact_current_Gena_parent_cases=35764,exact_current_Gena_parent_reviews=520,
                              all44_Sena_production_inputs_unchanged=True,original25_Sena_cases_not_promoted=True,
                              producer=dict(text=Path(__file__).read_text(),sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())),
                              scope='Parent merge preservation only; fresh merged checks and exact25 shared promotion remain separate. No new contextual or independent judgment.'),indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(files=len(files),manifest_sha256=sha(OUT.read_bytes()))))

scope: Parent merge preservation only; fresh merged checks and exact25 shared promotion remain separate. No new contextual or independent judgment.
